evaluationContext.purpose: Apply the multidimensional contract to a non-self-referential change that records and validates a live read-only Codex Desktop resource-observability preflight.
evaluationContext.domain: single-host Agent runtime resource observability and attribution gating
evaluationContext.evaluator: same-task Codex assessment using immutable Git objects, exact-commit isolated verification, and current repository reconciliation
evaluationContext.method: Git object binding, target-validator execution, unit testing, exact-commit archive verification, line-ending diagnosis, evidence-boundary review, and acceptance-map reconciliation
evaluationContext.claimScope: The eight files added or changed by commit 202cf047 only; not current Codex Desktop health, resource causation, release behavior, another host, or the whole Harness.

evidence.source: git ls-tree over all eight paths changed by 202cf04732272c646be2c8c15bf2bbccb749d113
evidence.scope: Eight Git blobs; full git ls-tree records sorted lexicographically, joined with UTF-8 LF, and no terminal newline; manifest SHA-256 dc5005db4b6773e0a6e856812d9991110dd93bf1f614c06f46eb73ffbb8df036.
limitations: Git identity proves the exact change-set bytes, not the truth of the earlier live observations.

evidence.scope: The target validator passed and its single consistency unit test passed in an isolated archive with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
limitations: The unit suite has one positive consistency test and no target-specific negative mutation tests.
The static validator checks the retained report; it does not replay the original live collection.

evidence.source: python -B scripts/verify.py in the exact 202cf047 Git archive
evidence.scope: Full verification failed before target integration closeout because a pre-existing durable RAW-REPORT.json expected Windows-CRLF SHA-256 6c40c51606cc6ed2330b3d725d9a81d0beea351a8420bbbefb4a93f8c7273c88 while the Git-normalized LF archive was 821861719e20fa601caf861781bdb32d005d5266fa3ab76e03024c37144453fd.
limitations: The failure is in an inherited process-fidelity evidence package, not in the resource-observability validator.
The same archive pattern affects four historical JSON byte hashes and may extend to other raw self-bindings; no repository-wide migration was attempted.

evidence.scope: One Windows 11 Codex Desktop 0.146.0 observation with a bounded task listing, nine configured MCP entries, three observer-excluded process samples, one classified snapshot, and explicit non-attribution decisions.
limitations: Raw process rows, command lines, collection commands, thread titles, and credentials were intentionally not retained.
The sample was neither idle nor a controlled same-workload repetition and does not prove cause, leak, release, or current state.

evidence.source: OpenAI Codex rust-v0.146.0 commit e363b08c9175ac1cbe5893615dd2cb9ddf95043b and dated upstream issue states retained in the target evidence
evidence.scope: Pinned protocol method names, two implementation blob identities, and four issue-state observations used only to bound available primitives and corroborating risk.
limitations: The assessment did not refetch upstream sources, and issue states are dated rather than current.
Upstream risk reports cannot establish local host causation.

evidence.source: AuthorityBoundary, observabilityDecision, claimBoundary, and documentation at 202cf047
evidence.scope: The retained package declares read-only observation, no model turn or runtime mutation, no retained raw command lines or credentials, and nine explicit false causation/control claims.
limitations: Repository absence and assertions support the retained-artifact boundary but cannot independently replay every collection-time side effect or redaction decision.

evidence.scope: The preflight was linked to acceptance.dynamic-runtime-control-gap-research as bounded evidence without upgrading autonomous control or self-authored-controller claims.
limitations: Program linkage is repository governance evidence, not external acceptance or product readiness.

unknowns: No controlled experiment shows that the observed footprint caused user-visible slowdown or that a later intervention would produce value.
limitations: The change narrows the problem and blocks unsafe action; it does not solve resource allocation or release.

unknowns: No independent reviewer confirmed that all user concerns and non-goals were preserved through collection, classification, and program integration.
limitations: The negative claim boundary is strong, while the intake-to-observation process trace is incomplete.

unknowns: No independent design review challenged the separation among inventory, ownership, attribution, actuation, and verification.
limitations: The architecture is a bounded evidence package and static validator, not an operational observer or controller.

unknowns: Mutation coverage and collection-to-report reconstruction behavior were not measured.
limitations: The validator is deterministic and passes, but its only dedicated unit test is a positive consistency check.
Exact-commit repository verification is not archive-portable because of inherited raw text hash semantics.

unknowns: No independent security or privacy review inspected the live collection surface, residual identifiers, or redaction completeness.
limitations: Sensitive raw command lines, credentials, and task text were not retained, which protects privacy but also limits replay and independent verification.

unknowns: No fresh upstream refetch was performed and no external issue-page content digest was retained.
limitations: Code and protocol references are revision-pinned, while issue state and interpretation remain dated metadata.

unknowns: No rollback drill or exact-commit remote CI result was retained.
limitations: The Git change is bounded and revertible, but an exact clean archive cannot pass the repository-wide verifier without resolving inherited line-ending hash semantics.

unknowns: Task-to-process ownership, context telemetry, release receipts, idle controls, repeated same-workload samples, and safe task-scoped actuation remain absent.
limitations: The package is a single-host snapshot and preflight decision, not a repeatable operational observability capability.

unknowns: No migration policy exists for historical runtime byte hashes versus Git-normalized durable bytes.
limitations: The validator hard-codes dated host counts, source versions, blob identities, and issue states.
The inherited CRLF/LF self-binding prevents checkout-independent verification.

unknowns: No accountable external owner accepted the interpretation or next gate.
limitations: The documentation makes decisions and prohibited claims visible, but responsibility has not been exercised through independent review.

unknowns: The live collection and classification path has no complete per-hop intent, omission, assumption, and redaction ledger.
limitations: Strong negative action boundaries preserve control, but they do not prove that the Agent retained every relevant signal or avoided classification loss.

unknowns: Collection overhead, verification cost, context cost, intervention benefit, idle baseline, and long-term maintenance burden were not measured.
limitations: The target records a resource footprint but cannot support an efficiency, savings, sustainability, or optimal-allocation claim.

floorResults.disposition: The target identity is exact and local claims stay bounded, but checkout-independent repository verification is blocked by inherited CRLF runtime-byte versus Git-LF durable-hash semantics.

floorResults.owner: repository owner and local host owner
floorResults.disposition: The retained artifact stays read-only, records no runtime mutation, and excludes raw command lines, credentials, and task content; collection-time replay remains a stated limit.

floorResults.owner: repository owner and future runtime acceptance authority
floorResults.disposition: The package denies attribution, actuation, controller necessity, cross-host parity, and release claims and is not treated as a completed runtime capability.

unknownsAndLimitations: This is a same-system assessment of a historical single-host observation package.
The original live collection cannot be independently replayed from retained raw rows because privacy-preserving redaction intentionally removed them.
Target-specific checks pass, while exact-commit full verification is blocked by inherited cross-checkout line-ending hash semantics.
The report cannot support current-host health, causal resource pressure, safe release, controller necessity, project-wide quality, or hard-standard admission.
counterevidenceAndDisagreements: Six repeated startup cohorts and multi-gigabyte aggregates are material observations but do not identify an owning task, lifecycle state, cause, or leak.
Official protocol primitives exist, contradicting a broad claim that Codex has no ownership or release surfaces, but the current task surface did not expose them.
A passing target validator does not cancel the exact-archive repository verification failure.
Privacy-preserving omission reduces data exposure while weakening independent replay; neither value cancels the other.
humanOrDomainDecisions: The repository owner must separately decide whether historical Windows-CRLF capture hashes remain runtime evidence alongside new Git-normalized durable digests or enter a governed hash-semantics migration.

nextEvidence: Obtain independent review of the dimension, floor, privacy, and portability judgments.
Define and test a non-destructive migration contract that separates historical captured-file hashes from Git-normalized durable-artifact hashes before changing existing evidence.
Run exact-commit or clean-clone verification on at least Windows and one LF-native environment after that contract exists.
For resource control, inspect current official ownership/release exposure before any separately authorized disposable lifecycle trial or self-authored controller.
nextEvidenceAndFallback.fallback: Retain 202cf047 as a single-host read-only inventory and negative attribution gate; do not use it for causal action, resource savings, current-host conclusions, or controller justification.

revalidationAndRetirementTriggers: Codex Desktop, app-server ownership, resource telemetry, or lifecycle release surfaces materially change.
The historical evidence hash semantics are migrated or a clean checkout becomes reproducibly verifiable.
Independent review finds a privacy, provenance, attribution, or classification defect.
A newer controlled same-workload observation supersedes the single-host snapshot.
A native or official resource governor makes the bounded preflight obsolete.

independentReview.scope: Tool-independent judgment of the live-observation interpretation, privacy boundary, archive-portability finding, and dimensional assessments remains absent.

acceptanceAuthority.owner: repository owner and separately governed runtime acceptance authority
acceptanceAuthority.scope: No current-host health, causal attribution, actuation, controller, cross-host, release, project-wide quality, CALIBRATION, ASSETS, or hard-standard acceptance is requested.

claimBoundary: Commit 202cf047 is an exact, bounded, non-self-referential resource-observability change whose target-specific checks pass and whose negative authority claims are useful; independent validity, privacy completeness, clean-checkout repository verification, causal attribution, operational control, efficiency, and acceptance remain unproved.
